visual_description: The image displays a stylized illustration of Santa Claus in his sleigh being pulled by nine reindeer against a red background with white snowflake motifs. The lead reindeer, Rudolph, is prominently featured on the right with a glowing red nose and decorative harness. Large bold text reads “HOW ‘RUDOLPH’ WENT DOWN IN HISTORY,” followed by a subtitle: “Two brothers-in-law created the most famous reindeer of all.” Below that, attribution reads “BY NEELY TUCKER.” In the upper left corner, small text notes: “The original sheet music for ‘Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer,’ written by Johnny Marks. Music Division. Courtesy of St. Nicholas Music Inc.” At the bottom left, page number “10” and publication title “LIBRARY OF CONGRESS MAGAZINE” are visible. No charts, tables, axes
